item.title: Canadian politicians, community groups share support after Australia Hannukah attack
item.description: TORONTO — Canadian politicians and community groups shared messages of support after a mass shooting left at least 15 people dead at a Hanukkah celebration in Australia.

item.title: Snow squalls expected in parts of southwestern Ontario
item.description: LONDON — Part of southwestern Ontario were under snow squall warnings Sunday as a winter storm continued to pummel the area with snowfall.

item.title: Canadian English supporters urge Carney to abandon federal shift to British spelling
item.description: OTTAWA — Promoters of Canadian English say the federal government is sending the wrong message to the world with its recent use of British spelling in official documents.

item.title: Authorities say they will release person of interest detained in Brown University shooting
B.C. braces for 'high impact' rain in flood-struck Fraser Valley and beyond
item.description: British Columbia is bracing for another "high impact" deluge of rain that's forecast to hit the province's Fraser Valley, after intense downpours and cross-border outflows last week inundated Abbotsford, triggered evacuations and cut major highways.

item.title: Former Hong Kong pro-democracy media mogul Jimmy Lai convicted in landmark national security trial
item.description: HONG KONG (AP) — Jimmy Lai , the pro-democracy former Hong Kong media mogul and outspoken critic of Beijing, was convicted in a landmark national security trial in the city’s court on Monday, which could send him to prison for the rest of his life.

item.title: Australian Prime Minister Albanese proposes tougher national gun laws after mass shooting in Sydney
item.description: SYDNEY (AP) — Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese on Monday proposed tougher national gun laws after a mass shooting targeted a Hanukkah celebration on Sydney's Bondi Beach , leaving at least 15 people dead.
